common.browserTitle: Open SSHUI in the desktop app
common.browserBody: This page needs the SSHUI backend, which only runs inside the desktop window. Close this browser tab and use the window that opens when you run:

validation.HostNameInvalidDomain: Invalid domain name: {{value}} (must contain at least one dot)
validation.HostNameConsecutiveDots: Invalid hostname: consecutive dots not allowed
validation.HostNameLabelInvalidHyphen: Invalid hostname label: {{label}} (cannot start/end with hyphen)
validation.IdentityFileEmpty: Identity file path cannot be empty
validation.IdentityFileExpandFailed: Cannot expand ~ in identity file path

settings.title: Settings
settings.maxBackupsHelp: Older backups will be automatically deleted
settings.subtitle: Appearance, backups and application preferences
settings.confirmDeleteHelp: Ask before deleting hosts, keys and backups or restoring a backup
settings.showGithubHelp: Account, SSH access, git identity and proxy for github.com
settings.show_npmHelp: Registry mirror, proxy and access tokens (~/.npmrc)
settings.show_dockerHelp: Registry logins and Docker Hub mirrors
settings.show_pipHelp: pip index mirror, extra indexes and proxy
settings.showProxyHelp: Proxy profiles you can switch for every tool at once, also from the tray
settings.show_envHelp: Edit your user PATH and environment variables
settings.show_wslHelp: Memory, networking and other .wslconfig settings; distributions
settings.show_rustHelp: crates.io and rustup mirrors, proxy and token
settings.show_goHelp: GOPROXY mirror, GOSUMDB, GOPRIVATE and GOTOOLCHAIN
settings.show_codexHelp: Model, approvals, sandbox, AGENTS.md, prompts and skills
settings.show_claudeHelp: API endpoint, models, permissions, CLAUDE.md, subagents, commands and skills

hosts.title: SSH Hosts
hosts.subtitle: Entries from your ~/.ssh/config
hosts.emptyHint: Add a host to start managing your SSH config.

keys.title: SSH Keys
keys.noKeysFound: No SSH keys found. Generate a new key to get started.
keys.subtitle: Private keys found in ~/.ssh and ~/.ssh-at/creds

config.title: Config Editor
config.infoMessage: Directly edit your SSH config file. Changes will be validated and backed up automatically.
config.subtitle: Edit ~/.ssh/config directly

backups.title: Backups
backups.infoMessage: SSH config backups are created automatically before each save. The last {{limit}} backups are kept.
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? Current config will be backed up first.
backups.noBackupsFound: No backups found. Backups will be created automatically when you save SSH config changes.
backups.subtitle: Automatic snapshots of ~/.ssh/config
backups.restoreConfirmOverwrite: Restore this backup? This will overwrite the current SSH config.

hostDialog.fieldHostHelper: Alias name for this host (spaces are removed automatically)
hostDialog.socks5ConfigHint: Configure SOCKS5 proxy for SSH connection

adv.connectionHint: Leave a field empty to use the OpenSSH default.
adv.connectTimeoutHelper: Give up if the server doesn't answer in time
adv.serverAliveIntervalHelper: Send a keepalive every N seconds to stop idle disconnects
adv.compressionHelper: Helps on slow links; usually slower on fast networks

strictHelp.default: Not written to the config. OpenSSH asks before trusting an unknown host.
strictHelp.accept-new: Trust hosts seen for the first time, but refuse if a known host's key changes. Recommended.
strictHelp.yes: Only connect to hosts already in known_hosts.
strictHelp.ask: Ask before trusting a new host.
strictHelp.no: Never checks host keys. Leaves you open to man-in-the-middle attacks.

adv.identitiesOnlyHelper: IdentitiesOnly — don't try other agent keys first; prevents “Too many authentication failures”
adv.forwardAgentHelper: Lets the remote host use your local keys. Only enable for servers you fully trust.
adv.legacyRsaHelper: Only for old servers that reject modern algorithms. Weakens security.
adv.forwardingHint: Opened while the SSH session is connected. Listen as [bind:]port, destination as host:port.
adv.otherOptionsHint: Any other ssh_config keyword for this host.
adv.errorListen: Use port or bind:port, e.g. 8080 or 127.0.0.1:8080
adv.errorManaged: Set this in its own field
adv.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted advanced options first
adv.errorListenTaken: Another forward already listens on this port

generateKeyDialog.title: Generate SSH Key
generateKeyDialog.keyTypeHelper: Ed25519 is recommended for new keys
generateKeyDialog.fieldBitsHelper: RSA key bit length, 4096 is more secure but slower to generate
generateKeyDialog.fieldNameHelper: Keys will be saved to ~/.ssh-at/creds/ directory
generateKeyDialog.fieldPassphraseHelper: Optional passphrase to protect the key
generateKeyDialog.subtitle: Create a new key pair on this machine

hostsFile.title: Hosts File
hostsFile.subtitle: Edit the system hosts file and switch between schemes with one click
hostsFile.nameTaken: A scheme with this name already exists
hostsFile.createSubtitle: A complete hosts file you can switch to with one click
hostsFile.deleteConfirm: Delete scheme "{{name}}"? The system hosts file is not changed.
hostsFile.outOfSync: The system hosts file no longer matches the active scheme "{{name}}".
hostsFile.systemHint: Edits are written straight to the system hosts file. Administrator permission may be requested.
hostsFile.schemeHint: Using a scheme replaces the system hosts file with its content. The previous file is backed up first.
hostsFile.loadError: Failed to load the hosts file

github.subtitle: Account, SSH access, git identity and proxy for github.com
github.cliMissingHint: SSHUI signs in through the GitHub CLI (gh), so your token stays in the system keyring.
github.notSignedInHint: Sign in with your browser using a one-time code.
github.signOutConfirm: Sign out of GitHub account “{{login}}”? The GitHub CLI and git over HTTPS will stop using it.
github.gitHttpsGh: git uses your GitHub CLI login for github.com
github.gitHttpsNone: No credential helper is set for github.com; git will prompt for a password.
github.signInHint: Enter this code on the GitHub page that just opened in your browser.
github.waiting: Waiting for you to authorize in the browser…
github.hostKeyUnknown: github.com isn't in known_hosts yet. Add GitHub's published keys so the first connection doesn't need a manual check.
github.hostKeysAdded: Added {{count}} GitHub host key entries to known_hosts
github.sshTestHint: Check which account your SSH keys sign in as (ssh -T git@github.com).
github.sshDenied: GitHub rejected your SSH keys. Add a public key to your GitHub account.
github.identityHint: Author name and email for your commits (git config --global). Use the email of your GitHub account so commits are linked to you.
github.gitProxyHint: git config --global http.proxy and https.proxy. Used by git for clone, pull and push over HTTPS. Test with an empty field to check a direct connection.
github.noProxy: No proxy set — git connects directly
github.proxiesDiffer: http.proxy ({{http}}) and https.proxy ({{https}}) differ; saving sets both.
github.proxyOk: github.com reachable through the proxy ({{ms}} ms)
github.proxyUnreachable: The proxy isn't running — nothing is listening on that address
github.envProxyNone: No HTTP(S)_PROXY / ALL_PROXY environment variables set.
github.envProxyHint: Used by the GitHub CLI and curl. Change them in your system environment variables.

devtools.notInstalledHint: {{name}} wasn't found on your PATH, so there's nothing to configure yet. Install it, then check again.
devtools.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL, e.g. https://…
devtools.envOverrides: These environment variables override the config file below:

npm.subtitle: Registry mirror, proxy and authentication in ~/.npmrc
npm.customRegistryHint: Any npm-compatible registry, such as a company Verdaccio or Nexus.
npm.httpsProxyHint: Proxy for https:// requests (most registries). Falls back to proxy when empty.
npm.noproxyHint: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the proxy.
npm.strictSslOff: Certificate checks are off — only use this behind a trusted intercepting proxy.
npm.noAuthHint: Public packages install without logging in.
npm.addTokenHint: Create one at npmjs.com → Access Tokens (or your registry's equivalent). Leave the registry empty to use the current one.
npm.scopesHint: Install packages of a scope (e.g. @my-org) from a different registry, such as GitHub Packages.

pip.subtitle: Package index mirror and proxy for pip
pip.customIndexHint: Any PEP 503 simple index. Plain-http hosts are added to trusted-host automatically.
pip.extraIndexHint: Extra indexes searched as well as the main one, separated by spaces.
pip.trustedHostHint: Hosts allowed without valid HTTPS, separated by spaces.
pip.proxyHint: http(s):// or socks5:// proxy for all pip downloads.
pip.pipMissing: pip isn't available for this Python. Run "python -m ensurepip --upgrade" to install it. Settings are still saved to the config file.

docker.subtitle: Registry logins and mirrors
docker.noRegistries: Not logged in to any registry
docker.noRegistriesHint: Public images can be pulled without logging in.
docker.credsStoreHelper: Passwords are kept by the "{{helper}}" credential helper, not in config.json.
docker.credsStoreFile: Passwords are stored base64-encoded in config.json. Consider a credential helper.
docker.loginHint: Runs docker login. Docker must be running.
docker.serverHint: Leave empty for Docker Hub, or enter e.g. ghcr.io, registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com
docker.passwordHint: Passed to docker on stdin; SSHUI doesn't store it.
docker.mirrorsHint: Docker Hub pull-through mirrors in daemon.json. Restart Docker (Desktop) after saving.
docker.noMirrors: No mirrors — images are pulled from Docker Hub directly.
docker.mirrorsSaved: Mirrors saved. Restart Docker to apply.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.subtitle: Switch the proxy for git, npm, pip, Cargo, environment variables and Windows in one click
proxy.directHint: Removes the proxy from every included target.
proxy.emptyHint: Add one for each proxy you use, e.g. a local Clash/v2ray port or the office proxy.
proxy.noTargets: No targets are included and installed
proxy.deleteConfirm: Delete the proxy profile "{{name}}"? Tools keep their current settings.
proxy.restartNote: Programs that are already running, including open terminals, keep the environment variables they started with. Restart them to use the new proxy.

targetHints.cargo: Used by cargo; rustup reads the environment variables
targetHints.env: Read by curl, Go, rustup, Python and most CLI tools
targetHints.claude: HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY and NO_PROXY in its settings

proxy.name: Name
proxy.urlHint: http://host:port, or socks5://host:port. Add user:password@ before the host if the proxy needs a login.
proxy.urlInvalid: Use http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h:// followed by host:port
proxy.noProxyHint: Comma-separated hosts that connect directly, e.g. localhost,127.0.0.1,.corp.com
proxy.nameTaken: A profile with this name already exists

env.title: Environment variables
env.subtitle: Your user PATH and variables (HKCU\Environment)
env.systemReadOnlyHint: System variables apply to every user and need administrator rights; change them in the Windows dialog.
env.restartNote: New terminals and programs get the changes. Programs that are already running keep their old environment until restarted.
env.name: Name
env.valueHint: %OTHER_VAR% references are expanded when the variable is used.
env.usePathEditor: Edit PATH in the PATH editor above
env.nameTaken: This variable already exists; edit it instead
env.windowsOnlyHint: On macOS and Linux, set environment variables in your shell profile (~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc).

rust.subtitle: crates.io mirror, rustup mirror, proxy and token
rust.customMirrorHint: A sparse index (sparse+https://…/) or a git index URL. Written as a source replacement in Cargo's config.
rust.replacedWith: crates.io is currently replaced by the source "{{name}}", which isn't a registry mirror (for example vendored sources). Choosing a mirror here replaces it.
rust.customRustupHint: The server for RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER; RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT is set to <url>/rustup.
rust.rustupEnvNote: Saved as the user environment variables RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER and RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT. Open a new terminal to use it.
rust.rustupEnvNoteUnix: rustup reads RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER and RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT from your shell profile; set them there.
rust.proxyHint: Proxy for cargo's downloads and git fetches. Overrides HTTPS_PROXY for cargo.
rust.checkRevokeHint: Check certificate revocation (Windows). Turn off if downloads fail with CRYPT_E_REVOCATION_OFFLINE behind a proxy.
rust.gitFetchHint: Use the git command line for git dependencies, so git's own proxy and credentials apply.
rust.tokenHint: Needed for cargo publish. Create one at crates.io → Account Settings → API Tokens. Stored in credentials.toml.

go.subtitle: Module proxy, checksum database and private modules
go.customProxyHint: Comma-separated proxies, tried in order; end with ,direct to fall back to the source repository.
go.proxyInvalid: Use proxy URLs, direct or off, separated by commas
go.sumdbHint: Checksum database used to verify downloaded modules.
go.privateHint: Module path patterns fetched directly and not checked against the checksum database, comma-separated.
go.noSpaces: Separate patterns with commas, not spaces
go.toolchainHint: Whether go may download a newer toolchain when go.mod asks for one.

wsl.subtitle: Global WSL 2 settings in .wslconfig and your distributions
wsl.shutdownConfirm: Shut down every running WSL distribution? Unsaved work inside WSL will be lost.
wsl.shutdownDone: WSL was shut down. Settings apply the next time it starts.
wsl.restartNeeded: Saved. Shut down WSL to apply the changes.
wsl.restartHint: Changes apply after WSL restarts (WSL shuts down by itself when idle).
wsl.noDistrosHint: Install one with "wsl --install -d Ubuntu" or from the Microsoft Store.
wsl.sizeInvalid: Use a size such as 8GB or 512MB

help.memory: Maximum memory for the WSL VM. Default: half of your RAM.
help.swap: Swap size; 0 turns swap off. Default: a quarter of the memory.
help.vmIdleTimeout: Milliseconds before an idle VM shuts down. Default: 60000.
help.networkingMode: mirrored shares Windows' network interfaces, so localhost and the Windows proxy work inside WSL.
help.dnsTunneling: Resolve DNS through Windows, which helps with VPNs.
help.firewall: Apply Windows Firewall rules to WSL traffic.
help.autoProxy: Use the Windows system proxy inside WSL.
help.localhostForwarding: Reach ports opened in WSL from Windows via localhost (NAT mode).
help.hostAddressLoopback: Reach Windows services from WSL through the host's IP (mirrored mode).
help.autoMemoryReclaim: How WSL returns cached memory to Windows.

wsl.notInstalledHint: WSL isn't set up on this PC. Run "wsl --install" in an administrator terminal (a restart may be needed), then check again.

groupHints.global: Read at the start of every session, in every project
groupHints.override: AGENTS.override.md replaces AGENTS.md while it exists
groupHints.skills: Folders with a SKILL.md the agent loads when relevant
groupHints.agents: Specialised agents Claude can delegate to
groupHints.outputStyles: Change how Claude responds, chosen with /output-style

agents.nameTaken: A file with this name already exists
agents.discardChanges: Discard the unsaved changes to this file?
agents.rawHint: The whole file. It's checked to be valid {{format}} before saving, and the previous version is kept next to it with a .sshui-bak extension.

codex.subtitle: Model, approvals, sandbox and AGENTS.md
codex.moreInConfig: MCP servers, model providers, profiles and everything else can be edited in the config.toml tab.

help.model: The model Codex uses by default.
help.model_reasoning_effort: How much the model thinks before answering. Higher is slower and more thorough.
help.model_provider: Which provider serves the model; custom ones are defined under [model_providers].
help.approval_policy: When Codex asks before running a command.
help.sandbox_mode: What commands may touch: read-only, the workspace, or everything.

claude.subtitle: API endpoint, models, permissions and CLAUDE.md
claude.replaceSecret: Enter a new value to replace it
claude.otherEnvHint: Set for every Claude Code session, e.g. HTTPS_PROXY or DISABLE_TELEMETRY.
claude.moreInSettings: Hooks, status line, MCP settings and everything else can be edited in the settings.json tab.

rules.allow: Tools and commands that run without asking.
rules.ask: Always ask before these, even if allowed elsewhere.

help.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: API endpoint. Set it to use a gateway or a compatible provider.
help.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: Sent as a Bearer token; used by most gateways.
help.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: An Anthropic API key, sent as x-api-key.
help.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: Model used for the "haiku" alias and background tasks.
help.model: Default model or alias, e.g. opus or sonnet. ANTHROPIC_MODEL takes precedence.
help.defaultMode: Permission mode new sessions start in.

agentProfiles.title: API profiles

officialHint.claude: Anthropic's own API with your Claude login; removes any custom endpoint and key.
officialHint.codex: OpenAI with your ChatGPT sign-in or API key; removes the SSHUI provider.

applied.claude: Switched to "{{name}}". New Claude Code sessions use it.
applied.codex: Switched to "{{name}}". New Codex sessions use it.

baseUrlHint.codex: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ending in /v1. Written as a [model_providers.sshui] entry.

agentProfiles.keyHint: Stored in ~/.ssh-at/agent-profiles.json and written to the tool's config when the profile is used.
agentProfiles.modelHint: Optional. Empty means the tool's default.
agentProfiles.deleteConfirm: Delete the profile "{{name}}"? The current configuration isn't changed.
agentProfiles.unsavedLive: The current configuration ({{url}}) isn't saved as a profile yet.
agentProfiles.modifiedLive: The current models don't match any profile; using a profile replaces them.
agentProfiles.envBaseUrl: OPENAI_BASE_URL is set to {{url}} in your environment, so the official profile actually goes there. Save it as a profile to switch to and from it here.
